title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (5/20): Xiao Lin's Allergy Test
note_en: 一边…一边… marks two actions happening at the same time: 医生一边听，一边把这些信息都记录在病历上 "the doctor wrote all this down in his chart as she listened." English uses "as" or "while" for one of the actions; Chinese puts 一边 in front of each verb, giving them equal weight.
